m: 1. भञ्ज् cl. 7. P. (Dhātup. xxix, 16) भनक्ति (pf. बभञ्ज, RV. &c., 3. pl. Ā. बभञ्जिरे, Hariv.; aor. अभाङ्क्षीत्, MBh.; fut. भङ्क्ष्यति, ˚क्ता, ib.; ind.p. भङ्क्त्वा, भक्त्वा or -भज्य, ib.), to break, shatter, split, RV. &c. &c.; to break into, make a breach in (a fortress, with acc.), Hit.; to rout, put to flight, defeat (an army), MBh.; Hariv.; Rājat.; to dissolve (an assembly), Hcar.; to break up i.e. divide (a Sūtra), Siddh.; to bend, R.; to check, arrest, suspend, frustrate, disappoint, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Pass. भज्यते (ep. also ˚ति; aor. अभाजि or अभञ्जि, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 33), to be broken or break (intr.) &c., AV. &c. &c.: Caus. भञ्जयति (aor. अबभञ्जत्) Gr.: Desid. बिभङ्क्षति, ib. : Intens. बम्भज्यते or ˚जीति, ib.
भञ्ज् [Perhaps for orig. भ्रञ्ज्; cf. भ्रज्; Lat. frangere, nau-fraga; Germ. brechen; Eng. break.]
2. भञ्ज् (√ 2. भञ्ज्, cl. 10. P. भञ्जयति), ‘to speak’ or ‘to shine’, Dhātup. xxxiii, 86.

s: strI, (Banakti BayAdikamiti । BaYja + ac । wAp .) annapUrRA । yaTA, -- “BItihA BayahantrI ca BAvanAvaSavarttinI । BImANgavAsinI BaYjA BittisaMvittivardDinI ॥” iti rudrayAmale saptavidyArahasyam ॥
m: भञ्˚जा f. N. of Durgā, L.
भञ्˚जी f. See शाल-भञ्जी.

m: भञ्जक mf(इका)n. who or what breaks or divides or destroys, W.
भञ्जक m. a breaker (of doors), Kull.
भञ्˚जम् See मृणाल-भञ्जम्.

m: भञ्˚जन mfn. breaking, a breaker, destroyer, dispeller, R.; Kathās. &c.
causing violent pain, Suśr.

भञ्˚जन n. breaking, shattering, crushing, destroying, annihilating, frustrating, MBh.; R. &c.
violent pain (अङ्ग-भ्˚), Suśr.
disturbing, interrupting, dispelling, removing, Pañcar.; Mallin. &c.
smoothing (of hair), Viddh.
